messages.title: Insufficient endorsement for position
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name}, hope you are doing well. I'm part of the VATPAC ATS Standards Team and our system has flagged that you're currently logged onto a position without the required endorsement for that position. Please let me know if you believe this is an error on our side. Otherwise, you're welcome to control any of the other positions listed here that don't have additional prerequisites: vatpac.org/controllers/position. Thanks!

messages.title: Solo endorsement expired
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name}, hope you are doing well. I'm part of the VATPAC ATS Standards Team and our system has flagged that your solo endorsement for the position you're currently controlling has expired. Please disconnect from the position for now and get in touch with your instructor to check their current plan for your solo endorsement. In the meantime, you're welcome to control any positions you hold the required endorsement for. Please let me know if you believe this has been flagged in error or your instructor has recently extended/renewed your endorsement. Thanks!

messages.title: Multiple ATIS on DEL, GND or TWR
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name}, hope you are doing well. I'm part of the VATPAC ATS Standards Team and our system has flagged that you've created multiple ATIS broadcasts while controlling a DEL, GND or TWR position. Only TCU and ENR controllers are permitted to create multiple ATIS broadcasts, so please remove any additional ATIS and retain only the one applicable to your position. Thanks!
